user: And the FX spread if I pay in USD?
answer:
For a tier1 account, the FX spread is **1.5%** over the mid-market rate. It applies only after your monthly free conversion allowance of **EUR 500** is used up. Within that allowance, no spread is charged.

I can't tell from my tools how much of your EUR 500 allowance you've already used this month, so I can't say whether a USD conversion would be spread-free.

Card payments also carry a separate **1.2%** fee on the EUR equivalent, with no flat fee. The knowledge base doesn't explicitly say whether a USD card payment also incurs the FX spread, so I can't confirm the combined cost.

If you tell me the amount in EUR, I can run a full quote showing the mid rate, spread, allowance and final USD amount. For confirmation of how card payments in USD are priced, I can escalate to a human agent.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## FX spreads by tier
The spread is applied over the mid-market rate only after the free monthly
conversion allowance is exhausted.

| Tier | FX spread | Free monthly conversion allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 1.5% | EUR 500 |
| Tier 2 | 0.9% | EUR 1,000 |
| Tier 3 | 0.5% | EUR 5,000 |

Currency conversion guide
## How a conversion is priced
A conversion quote has these components, in order: the mid-market rate for the
currency pair; the tier spread (a percentage of the gross converted amount);
the free monthly conversion allowance. If the whole conversion fits within the
customer's remaining monthly allowance, no spread is charged. Once the
allowance is exhausted, the full tier spread applies to the conversion.

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.
